items.description: RIYADH: I read Naoko Higashi’s “The Soul Catchers” over two evenings — enjoying a few chapters before bed with a mug of hot chocolate — and it was perfectly suited to the cozier rhythm as we move into the end of the year. The premise was unusual enough to keep me curious, and I appreciated its short chapters that made it an easy book to return to for a quick reading session.
